title: Java Software Development & Backend Engineering Intern
description:
### **Build Enterprise Applications | Develop Backend Solutions | Gain Real-World Project Experience**

### **Job Description**

Wahy Lab Solutions is seeking motivated and enthusiastic candidates for the position of Java Software Development & Backend Engineering Intern. The role involves developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining Java-based applications while gaining practical exposure to backend development, database integration, REST APIs, and enterprise application development through industry-oriented projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Write, test, debug, and maintain clean, efficient, and reusable Java code.
* Apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and core Java concepts.
* Assist in developing backend services, web applications, and enterprise software solutions.
* Work with relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL using SQL and JDBC.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend application components.
* Gain practical exposure to Spring Boot and related Java development frameworks.
* Perform unit testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and basic performance optimisation.
* Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and software development activities.
* Assist in identifying and resolving application errors and technical issues.
* Maintain technical documentation and project reports.
* Collaborate with developers and project teams on real-world software development projects.

### **Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Java programming and Core Java concepts.
* Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), collections, and exception handling.
* Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, and database operations.
* Basic understanding of JDBC and REST API concepts.
* Awareness of Spring Boot and Java web development is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is preferred.
* Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and version control is an added advantage.
* Understanding of debugging, testing, and coding best practices.
* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, teamwork, and willingness to learn.

### **Qualification**

* Any Degree / Diploma / PG / ITI.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates interested in Java development, backend engineering, and enterprise application development are encouraged to apply.

### **Job Details**

* Job Title: Java Software Development & Backend Engineering Intern
* Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time
* Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO) / Work from Home (WFH) / Hybrid
* Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

### **Career Opportunities**

This internship can help candidates prepare for future roles such as:

* Java Developer
* Java Backend Developer
* Spring Boot Developer
* Software Engineer
* Enterprise Application Developer
* Junior Backend Engineer

### **Why Join Us?**

* Enterprise Tech Stack Exposure: Gain hands-on exposure to Core Java, Spring Boot, JDBC, and relational database architectures.
* Scalable Backend Systems: Work on real-world enterprise applications, RESTful microservices, and database integration workflows.
* Industry Best Practices: Learn professional software engineering practices including Git workflows, unit testing, code reviews, and API design.
* Strong Career Launchpad: Build an enterprise-grade software project portfolio to fast-track your career as a Java Backend Engineer.

### **Apply Now and Start Building Your Career in Java Development!**

Interested candidates may apply by mailing their resume on hr@wahylab.com

**Technologies and Tools**

* Hands\-on experience with Spring , Spring Boot.

* Basic understanding of Java Memory Management (JMM) including garbage collections concepts.
* Experience in RDBMS or NoSQL databases and writing SQL queries
* Hands\-on experience in creating RESTful webservices and consuming webservices
* Familiar with CI/CD pipeline
* Good understanding of any of the cloud technologies.

title: Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead
description:
**Job Title \- Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead – Specialist – ACS Song**

**Management Level: Level 9 \- Specialist**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must have skills: Salesforce Generic**

**Good to have skills: Salesforce B2B Commerce**

**Experience: 5–8 years of experience in Salesforce B2B Commerce and related technologies**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (accurate educational details should be captured)**

**Job Summary**


We are seeking an experienced and motivated Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead – Specialist with 5–8 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable eCommerce solutions on Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce platform capabilities, with proven experience in both backend and frontend development. You will lead technical delivery, mentor team members, and ensure adherence to best practices while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive successful multi\-market rollouts.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Own the technical direction and ensure delivery of high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce B2B Commerce solutions.
* Lead and mentor developers, providing guidance through code reviews, technical planning, and solution design.
* Design, develop, debug, unit test, and document complex Salesforce applications and integrations.
* Develop and customize Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Communities for B2B Commerce Cloud.
* Implement Apex Classes, Triggers (before/after insert, update, delete), and Scheduler Classes for automation.
* Create and manage Flows (Schedule\-triggered, AutoLaunched, Record\-triggered) and modify standard checkout flows.
* Make architectural and design decisions ensuring scalability, maintainability, and compliance with Salesforce standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align technical implementation with business requirements.
* Proactively identify technical risks and propose improvements across the codebase and processes.
* Ensure proper validation checks, error handling, and user experience enhancements (e.g., Toast Notifications).
* Act as a key troubleshooter in complex/escalated incidents and provide innovative solutions.
* Manage multi\-market rollouts including multi\-currency and multi\-language implementations.
* Ensure adherence to CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, and Salesforce best practices.

  

**Professional and Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud (LWR template, checkout flows, staged rollouts).
* Hands\-on experience in Apex programming (Classes, Triggers, Scheduler, Batch jobs).
* Proficiency in Lightning Web Components (LWC) including lifecycle hooks (connectedCallback, renderedCallback), directives (for:each, iterator, if:true), and decorators (@track, @wire, @api).
* Experience with frontend customization: styling LWC with custom CSS, applying validation checks, and building reusable components.
* Knowledge of Salesforce Communities and integration with external APIs.
* Strong understanding of SOQL, data loading activities (Data Loader, Workbench), and permission set assignments.
* Experience with GitHub, Bitbucket, and code management tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and code quality tools (SonarQube).
* Exposure to multi\-threaded integrations, caching mechanisms, and API\-driven commerce flows.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and logical skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure and deliver within deadlines.

**Additional Information**

description:
Location: Kochi
Other locations: Anywhere in Country
Salary: Competitive

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744261
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect**
=========================================================


**Job Title:**



SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect

  


**Job Summary:**



The SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect will provide technical delivery leadership and architecture direction for large\-scale SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA migration initiatives, enterprise integration, application modernization, and global delivery execution. The role requires significant SAP technology experience, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, and outcome\-focused SAP solutions.

  


**Responsibilities:**


* Provide leadership for global SAP application delivery across major transformation workstreams, including S/4HANA migration, integration, modernization, deployment, and stabilization.
* Establish architecture direction for enterprise SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SuccessFactors, HCM, and related non\-SAP platforms.
* Provide delivery governance, technical decision leadership, and direction across matrixed global teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders.

  


**Key responsibilities include:**


**Delivery \& Program Management**


* Develop and manage SAP technical delivery plans across global programs, with accountability for execution quality, milestone discipline, and alignment to business outcomes.
* Lead technical workstreams responsible for custom development, integrations, environments, deployments, production readiness, and stabilization.
* Define release strategy, cutover approach, governance routines, escalation pathways, and delivery risk mitigation plans.

  


**SAP Architecture \& Integration**


* Design scalable SAP architecture patterns that support Clean Core principles, extensibility, integration reuse, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Provide architecture leadership across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Integration Suite, SAP BTP, SuccessFactors, SAP HCM, APIs, IDocs, and non\-SAP integrations.
* Support modernization decisions that reduce technical debt, improve platform resilience, and enable enterprise\-scale SAP transformation outcomes.

  


**Application Development \& Support**


* Oversee SAP application design, build, testing, deployment, and support with clear quality gates and accountability across delivery teams.
* Lead technical reviews, performance analysis, defect triage, root\-cause resolution, and production readiness assessments for critical SAP capabilities.
* Ensure production support and warranty operations meet business continuity, service quality, and incident resolution expectations.

  


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**


* Partner with business leaders, technology executives, vendors, and delivery teams to align architecture decisions with program objectives and enterprise standards.
* Lead executive\-level solution reviews, requirement alignment sessions, technical steering discussions, and delivery status communications.
* Address escalations, change impacts, architectural trade\-offs, and delivery commitments through clear ownership and evidence\-based decision making.

  


**Leadership \& People Management**


* Lead matrixed global delivery teams across architecture, development, integration, testing, deployment, and support functions.
* Develop technical talent, strengthen delivery standards, and promote reusable methods, knowledge sharing, and architecture discipline across teams.

  


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**



The role requires sound judgment across architecture, delivery, risk, and stakeholder decisions in a matrixed global environment. The candidate will be expected to evaluate trade\-offs across SAP S/4HANA, integration, SAP BTP, Clean Core, security, performance, and delivery timelines while making evidence\-based decisions that protect business outcomes and enterprise standards.

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**


* 15\+ years of SAP technology experience, including senior accountability for technical delivery, architecture governance, and global transformation execution.
* Proven experience across full\-cycle SAP implementations, S/4HANA migrations, global rollouts, and complex application modernization programs.
* Deep understanding of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, event\-driven integration, SAP BTP, Clean Core principles, and side\-by\-side extensibility.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and related enterprise compliance requirements.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and leadership skills in matrixed global environments.

  


**Supervision Responsibilities:**



The role will provide technical leadership and delivery direction across matrixed global teams, including architects, developers, integration specialists, testing teams, vendors, and support resources. Responsibilities include coaching senior technical talent, strengthening architecture and delivery practices, and developing reusable capabilities that improve execution quality across programs.

  


**Other Requirements:**



Travel may be required up to 10% based on business needs.

  


**Job Requirements:**


**To qualify, candidates must have:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years in SAP technical roles, including 5\+ years leading application delivery, architecture, integration, or development teams.
* Demonstrated leadership of large\-scale SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA migration, global rollout, integration, cutover, and stabilization responsibilities.
* Hands\-on knowledge of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensibility, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and enterprise compliance\-related SAP capabilities.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, vendors, and global delivery teams.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.

  


**What we offer you**



At EY, we are committed to helping our people develop future\-focused skills and build meaningful careers in a diverse, inclusive, and globally connected environment.


* Career development: EY provides opportunities to develop future\-focused skills and gain experiences that support long\-term career growth.
* Flexible work arrangements: EY flexible work policies are designed to support balance, trust, and autonomy, subject to business and role requirements.
* Benefits: EY offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, flexibility, and personal and professional priorities.
* Compensation: A competitive compensation package will be offered, including salary, benefits, and potential performance\-based incentives.

Must Have

· **4\+ years of professional software engineering experience**

· Strong **Python** development skills

· Strong **SQL** skills

· Experience with **PostgreSQL** or equivalent relational databases

· Experience building **REST APIs**

· Experience with **FastAPI, Flask, Django or equivalent**

· Strong experience with **Pandas / NumPy**

· Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics or AI applications

· Experience with **Git/GitHub**

· Experience with **Docker**

· Experience deploying applications to a cloud environment

· Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills

· Understanding of software architecture and production engineering practices

Preferred

· Experience with **Streamlit**

· Data engineering / ETL

· API and third\-party system integrations

· CI/CD and GitHub Actions

· Application monitoring and logging

· Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture

· Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

· Can independently investigate and solve technical problems.

· Is comfortable working with incomplete or evolving requirements.

· Can make practical architecture and technology decisions.

· Can balance speed of delivery with engineering quality.

· Enjoys working across multiple technical areas rather than being restricted to one narrow function.
